create_env_renderer: create an EnvRenderer instance with a custom environment, title, camera, and window size
render_ground_texture: render a textured ground plane with configurable size, grid spacing, axis, and visual options
save_screen_capture: save a screenshot of the current renderer viewport to a specified directory with a given filename
update_camera_target: update the camera target position with optional per-axis ignore flags to constrain translation
toggle_render_flags: toggle renderer display flags such as ground, origin, and overlay via keyboard input
